snippet.title: Hamsteria! Itch Demo Trailer
snippet.description: Hamsteria! is a difficult 2 player Co-Op game where you're each a hamster in connected wheels. You only have the ability to spin your wheel forwards and backwards. You can not directly turn, and you do not have the ability to jump. To navigate, you must work together.
